Rank list mein Raju mila, Farhan mila... par Rancho? Gayab! Yahi hai interview ka famous sawaal: missing number!

Interviewer ne poocha: ek UNSORTED array hai, jismein ek se n tak ke alag-alag natural numbers hain... par ek number missing hai! Yahan n paanch hai. Raju paanch, Farhan do... aur Rancho, chaar, missing! Kaise dhoondhoge?
Agar sort karke iterate karoge, toh time complexity n log n ho jaayegi... aur interviewer tumhe reject kar dega!
Sabse aasaan tareeka, bachpan ki maths! Ek se n tak ka sum: n into n plus one, by two. Paanch into chheh by two... pandrah!
Ab array ka sum nikalo: teen, ek, paanch, do... gyaarah. Pandrah minus gyaarah... chaar! Mil gaya Rancho!
Na sorting, na extra space. Time O of n, space O of one. Bas itna simple tha!
